title: HamSCI Personal Space Weather Station Observations of the Gannon Geomagnetic Storm
description: HF Doppler analysis software accompanying Rebecca Potter's (KE2EBI) undergraduate thesis at the University of Scranton, studying the May 2024 Gannon geomagnetic storm with HamSCI Personal Space Weather Station (PSWS) GRAPE / RX888 observations. Includes the scripts that reproduce the thesis figures and broader GRAPE DigitalRF analysis, synthetic-spectrogram ray tracing, and sidescatter tooling. The supporting dataset is archived separately (see related identifiers).
